rows.limitation: Byzantine/Iranian suzerainty and changing dependency must be kept separate from target identity.

rows.limitation: Angkor is a capital/site locus; empire-wide geometry must not be inferred from the site boundary.

rows.limitation: Treaty of San Ildefonso in 1800 created a French title/cession claim, but Spanish administration and actual delivery to France continued until 1803. Annual anchor cannot safely collapse title, possession and governance.
rows.basis: National Archives records retrocession by treaty in 1800–1801 but formal delivery from Spain to France at New Orleans only on 30 Nov 1803. Hold before subject research.

rows.limitation: At 1800 the Solomonic imperial institution persists during Zemene Mesafint, but effective sovereignty is fragmented among regional lords; do not infer uniform imperial territorial practice.
rows.basis: 1800 falls within the Age of Princes; imperial identity persists while central authority is weak/fragmented.

rows.limitation: Bavaria was an Electorate from 1623 to 1806. The source-native label 'Duchy of Bavaria' is not valid for 1800. Do not silently replace it with Electorate of Bavaria.
rows.basis: Haus der Bayerischen Geschichte explicitly dates the Electorate of Bavaria 1623–1806. Hold without substitution.
